AND BREATHE CLEAN AIR

HVAC Zone Inc is a multi-service New Jersey Master HVACR contractor. From installation and repair to maintenance and indoor air quality, our in-house team of installers and service techs keeps homeowners, builders, and property managers comfortable year-round.

WHAT WE DO
Full-service heating, cooling & air quality

Residential and medium commercial — installation, repair, maintenance, and sales across most major brands on the market today.

Installation

New construction, replacements, and system upgrades — sized and engineered for your space, not just swapped in.

Repair

Fast, honest diagnostics on any brand. We find the root cause instead of just swapping parts.

Maintenance

Planned service plans that extend equipment life, keep efficiency up, and prevent the mid-season breakdown.

Indoor Air Quality

Filtration, ventilation, humidity control, and IAQ monitoring — because comfort means clean, healthy air.

Commercial & Builders

A capable team for property managers and building contractors — coordinated, reliable, and code-compliant.

Sales & Equipment

Multi-brand dealer with access to a wide network of manufacturers and vendors — the right equipment at fair pricing, no single-brand bias.

INDOOR AIR QUALITY
IAQ products we install & service

Clean air is half of comfort. These whole-home systems integrate with your HVAC equipment to filter, ventilate, and balance humidity — far beyond what a standard 1-inch filter can do. We specify, install, and service them all, with no single-brand bias.

Media air cleaners

High-MERV (MERV 13–16) media filtration built into your ductwork — captures dust, pollen, pet dander, and fine particles with minimal airflow loss.

UV-C germicidal lights

Ultraviolet light in the airstream and at the coil to reduce bacteria, viruses, and mold — and keep the evaporator coil clean for better efficiency.

Whole-home humidifiers

Bypass, fan-powered, and steam humidifiers that hold a healthy 30–50% relative humidity in winter — protecting sinuses, woodwork, and electronics.

Whole-home dehumidifiers

Tackle damp basements and humid summers, cut mold and dust-mite growth, and let you set the thermostat a few degrees higher while staying comfortable.

Ventilation (ERV / HRV)

Energy and heat recovery ventilators bring in fresh, filtered outdoor air and exhaust stale air while recovering the heating or cooling you already paid for.

Air purifiers & VOC control

Whole-home purifiers with carbon and photocatalytic stages that neutralize odors, smoke, and volatile organic compounds from cooking, cleaning, and furnishings.

Already monitoring your air? See our explainer on IAQ monitors & sensors. Guidance grounded in the U.S. EPA’s Indoor Air Quality resources. Not sure what you need? Request a consultation and we’ll assess your home or building.

WHY HVAC ZONE
A team capable — and the network to back it up

Our wide network of equipment manufacturers, vendors, engineering consultants, and contractors throughout the HVAC industry lets us help builders, property managers, and homeowners meet their needs. We run our own in-house team of installers and service techs, so the job gets done right — the first time.

JS

Javier Santiago
Founder & New Jersey Master HVACR Contractor, Lic. #19HC00897200

Coordinated scheduling and code-compliant installs that keep your project moving.
Most brands serviced

INDUSTRY OWNERSHIP
Meet the brands

The HVAC industry has consolidated into a handful of global parents, so several “competing” labels are actually built by the same company. Here’s who owns whom today — and what each brand is positioned to offer. We stay neutral: knowing the family tree helps you compare value, not pick a logo.

Daikin Industries
JAPAN
Official site →
The world’s largest air-conditioning manufacturer.
Daikin
Premium full line — high-efficiency furnaces, ACs and heat pumps, plus the industry’s widest ductless and VRF range.
Goodman
Value-oriented, builder-friendly equipment sold through distribution. Daikin’s high-volume brand.
Amana
Value tier sharing Goodman’s platform, set apart by stronger warranties — including a lifetime unit-replacement compressor warranty.
Carrier Global
USA
Official site →
Pioneered modern air conditioning; broad residential and commercial portfolio.
Carrier
Flagship premium brand; full residential and commercial line.
Bryant
Carrier’s dealer-channel sister brand — near-identical equipment under a different nameplate.
Payne
Builder / entry-level tier of the Carrier family.
ICP brands: Heil, Tempstar, Comfortmaker, Arcoaire, Day & Night, Keeprite
Value and contractor tiers sharing common platforms (International Comfort Products).
Viessmann Climate Solutions ACQUIRED 2024
European heat-pump and heating leader added to Carrier’s portfolio.
Trane Technologies
USA / IRELAND
Official site →
Global climate-innovation company spanning residential and commercial.
Trane
Premium brand with deep commercial heritage and high-efficiency residential equipment.
American Standard Heating & Air Conditioning
Trane’s consumer sister brand — comparable engineering under a different name.
Oxbox
Contractor-direct, online-first value brand.
RunTru
Budget / builder tier.
Thermo Pride
Rugged, long-life oil-fired furnaces.
Rheem Manufacturing
USA / PALOMA (JAPAN)
Official site →
Air and water-heating specialist; owned by Paloma Industries of Japan.
Rheem
Full residential and commercial line sold through retail and contractor channels.
Ruud
Contractor-channel sister brand — same equipment as Rheem under a different label.
Nortek / Nordyne family ACQUIRED OCT 2024
Frigidaire HVAC, Maytag HVAC, Miller, Gibson and Intertherm — value, retail and manufactured-housing tiers; plus Broan ventilation.
Fujitsu General ACQUIRED 2025
Ductless mini-split brand added to the Paloma/Rheem group.
Value tiers: Richmond, Sure Comfort, WeatherKing
Entry-level and private-label water-heating and HVAC lines.
Bosch Home Comfort Group
GERMANY
NEW OWNER 2025
Official site →
Acquired Johnson Controls’ residential & light-commercial HVAC business in August 2025 — a major ownership shift.
York
Mid-tier dealer brand (formerly Johnson Controls).
Coleman
Manufactured-housing and residential value brand (formerly Johnson Controls).
Luxaire
York’s sister brand (formerly Johnson Controls).
Champion
Value tier (formerly Johnson Controls).
JCI–Hitachi Air Conditioning JV
The former Johnson Controls–Hitachi joint venture moved to Bosch with the deal.
Lennox International
USA
Official site →
Premium residential and commercial; dealer-only distribution.
Lennox
Flagship premium brand known for high-efficiency, smart-home-ready equipment.
Armstrong Air
Lennox engineering at a lower price point — built by Allied Air Enterprises.
Allied Air Enterprises: AirEase, Concord, Ducane, Allied Commercial, MagicPak
Value and specialty tiers under the Lennox-owned Allied umbrella.
Mitsubishi Electric
JAPAN
Official site →
Global leader in ductless and variable-refrigerant-flow systems.
Mitsubishi Electric (Mr. Slim, City Multi, M-/P-Series)
Premium ductless mini-splits and VRF; strong cold-climate heat-pump performance.
Samsung
SOUTH KOREA
Official site →
Tech-forward HVAC within the Samsung group.
Samsung HVAC
WindFree ductless and Digital VRF systems with smart-home integration.
LG Electronics
SOUTH KOREA
Official site →
Design- and connectivity-focused HVAC.
LG HVAC
Art Cool and Multi F ductless, Multi V VRF — strong on design and smart controls.
Gree Electric Appliances
CHINA
Official site →
One of the world’s largest air-conditioner manufacturers; a major OEM for other labels.
Gree
High-volume residential and light-commercial full line.
TOSOT
Gree’s lifestyle sub-brand for comfort and appliances.
KINGHOME
Gree sub-brand.
Midea Group
CHINA
Official site →
One of the world’s largest appliance and HVAC manufacturers. Midea is a major OEM — it builds equipment sold under many other labels, not just its own name.
Cooper & Hunter
Value-oriented ductless brand (Ukraine-founded, distributed in the US by ComfortSide). Its mini-splits are rebadged Midea units — Midea is the manufacturer, not the brand’s corporate owner. Some models are sourced from Gree.
Also OEM-built on Midea platforms
Carrier and Bryant ductless systems, the Bosch Climate 5000 series, MRCOOL and Durastar are widely reported to use Midea equipment.
TCL Technology
CHINA
GROWING FAST
Official site →
Consumer-electronics giant that has become one of the world’s largest air-conditioner exporters — roughly 20 million AC units a year across 160+ countries.
TCL Air Conditioner (T-Pro, FreshIN, BreezeIN, SaveIN AI)
Ductless mini-splits, window units, portables and light-commercial systems; value-to-mid positioning with smart-home and AI energy-saving features. Sold via retail (e.g., Home Depot) and as OEM/ODM for other labels.

Ownership and brand-positioning details compiled from Carrier’s brand portfolio, Carrier’s Viessmann acquisition, Bosch on the Johnson Controls HVAC acquisition, Rheem / Paloma and the Nortek acquisition, Nortek/Nordyne under Rheem, ServiceTitan’s manufacturer guide, Allied Air Enterprises (Lennox), Gree / TOSOT / KINGHOME, and reporting on Midea as the manufacturer behind Cooper & Hunter and other labels and Midea vs. Cooper & Hunter, TCL’s scale and product range, and TCL air-conditioner manufacturing overview. Accurate as of July 2026; M&A in this sector moves quickly, so we revisit periodically.

INDOOR AIR QUALITY
IAQ products we install & service

Clean air is half of comfort. These whole-home systems integrate with your HVAC equipment to filter, ventilate, and balance humidity — far beyond what a standard 1-inch filter can do. We specify, install, and service them all, with no single-brand bias.

Media air cleaners

High-MERV (MERV 13–16) media filtration built into your ductwork — captures dust, pollen, pet dander, and fine particles with minimal airflow loss.

UV-C germicidal lights

Ultraviolet light in the airstream and at the coil to reduce bacteria, viruses, and mold — and keep the evaporator coil clean for better efficiency.

Whole-home humidifiers

Bypass, fan-powered, and steam humidifiers that hold a healthy 30–50% relative humidity in winter — protecting sinuses, woodwork, and electronics.

Whole-home dehumidifiers

Tackle damp basements and humid summers, cut mold and dust-mite growth, and let you set the thermostat a few degrees higher while staying comfortable.

Ventilation (ERV / HRV)

Energy and heat recovery ventilators bring in fresh, filtered outdoor air and exhaust stale air while recovering the heating or cooling you already paid for.

Air purifiers & VOC control

Whole-home purifiers with carbon and photocatalytic stages that neutralize odors, smoke, and volatile organic compounds from cooking, cleaning, and furnishings.

Already monitoring your air? See our explainer on IAQ monitors & sensors. Guidance grounded in the U.S. EPA’s Indoor Air Quality resources. Not sure what you need? Request a consultation and we’ll assess your home or building.

INDUSTRY OWNERSHIP
Meet the brands

The HVAC industry has consolidated into a handful of global parents, so several “competing” labels are actually built by the same company. Here’s who owns whom today — and what each brand is positioned to offer. We stay neutral: knowing the family tree helps you compare value, not pick a logo.

Daikin Industries
JAPAN
Official site →
The world’s largest air-conditioning manufacturer.
Daikin
Premium full line — high-efficiency furnaces, ACs and heat pumps, plus the industry’s widest ductless and VRF range.
Goodman
Value-oriented, builder-friendly equipment sold through distribution. Daikin’s high-volume brand.
Amana
Value tier sharing Goodman’s platform, set apart by stronger warranties — including a lifetime unit-replacement compressor warranty.
Carrier Global
USA
Official site →
Pioneered modern air conditioning; broad residential and commercial portfolio.
Carrier
Flagship premium brand; full residential and commercial line.
Bryant
Carrier’s dealer-channel sister brand — near-identical equipment under a different nameplate.
Payne
Builder / entry-level tier of the Carrier family.
ICP brands: Heil, Tempstar, Comfortmaker, Arcoaire, Day & Night, Keeprite
Value and contractor tiers sharing common platforms (International Comfort Products).
Viessmann Climate Solutions ACQUIRED 2024
European heat-pump and heating leader added to Carrier’s portfolio.
Trane Technologies
USA / IRELAND
Official site →
Global climate-innovation company spanning residential and commercial.
Trane
Premium brand with deep commercial heritage and high-efficiency residential equipment.
American Standard Heating & Air Conditioning
Trane’s consumer sister brand — comparable engineering under a different name.
Oxbox
Contractor-direct, online-first value brand.
RunTru
Budget / builder tier.
Thermo Pride
Rugged, long-life oil-fired furnaces.
Rheem Manufacturing
USA / PALOMA (JAPAN)
Official site →
Air and water-heating specialist; owned by Paloma Industries of Japan.
Rheem
Full residential and commercial line sold through retail and contractor channels.
Ruud
Contractor-channel sister brand — same equipment as Rheem under a different label.
Nortek / Nordyne family ACQUIRED OCT 2024
Frigidaire HVAC, Maytag HVAC, Miller, Gibson and Intertherm — value, retail and manufactured-housing tiers; plus Broan ventilation.
Fujitsu General ACQUIRED 2025
Ductless mini-split brand added to the Paloma/Rheem group.
Value tiers: Richmond, Sure Comfort, WeatherKing
Entry-level and private-label water-heating and HVAC lines.
Bosch Home Comfort Group
GERMANY
NEW OWNER 2025
Official site →
Acquired Johnson Controls’ residential & light-commercial HVAC business in August 2025 — a major ownership shift.
York
Mid-tier dealer brand (formerly Johnson Controls).
Coleman
Manufactured-housing and residential value brand (formerly Johnson Controls).
Luxaire
York’s sister brand (formerly Johnson Controls).
Champion
Value tier (formerly Johnson Controls).
JCI–Hitachi Air Conditioning JV
The former Johnson Controls–Hitachi joint venture moved to Bosch with the deal.
Lennox International
USA
Official site →
Premium residential and commercial; dealer-only distribution.
Lennox
Flagship premium brand known for high-efficiency, smart-home-ready equipment.
Armstrong Air
Lennox engineering at a lower price point — built by Allied Air Enterprises.
Allied Air Enterprises: AirEase, Concord, Ducane, Allied Commercial, MagicPak
Value and specialty tiers under the Lennox-owned Allied umbrella.
Mitsubishi Electric
JAPAN
Official site →
Global leader in ductless and variable-refrigerant-flow systems.
Mitsubishi Electric (Mr. Slim, City Multi, M-/P-Series)
Premium ductless mini-splits and VRF; strong cold-climate heat-pump performance.
Samsung
SOUTH KOREA
Official site →
Tech-forward HVAC within the Samsung group.
Samsung HVAC
WindFree ductless and Digital VRF systems with smart-home integration.
LG Electronics
SOUTH KOREA
Official site →
Design- and connectivity-focused HVAC.
LG HVAC
Art Cool and Multi F ductless, Multi V VRF — strong on design and smart controls.
Gree Electric Appliances
CHINA
Official site →
One of the world’s largest air-conditioner manufacturers; a major OEM for other labels.
Gree
High-volume residential and light-commercial full line.
TOSOT
Gree’s lifestyle sub-brand for comfort and appliances.
KINGHOME
Gree sub-brand.
Midea Group
CHINA
Official site →
One of the world’s largest appliance and HVAC manufacturers. Midea is a major OEM — it builds equipment sold under many other labels, not just its own name.
Cooper & Hunter
Value-oriented ductless brand (Ukraine-founded, distributed in the US by ComfortSide). Its mini-splits are rebadged Midea units — Midea is the manufacturer, not the brand’s corporate owner. Some models are sourced from Gree.
Also OEM-built on Midea platforms
Carrier and Bryant ductless systems, the Bosch Climate 5000 series, MRCOOL and Durastar are widely reported to use Midea equipment.
TCL Technology
CHINA
GROWING FAST
Official site →
Consumer-electronics giant that has become one of the world’s largest air-conditioner exporters — roughly 20 million AC units a year across 160+ countries.
TCL Air Conditioner (T-Pro, FreshIN, BreezeIN, SaveIN AI)
Ductless mini-splits, window units, portables and light-commercial systems; value-to-mid positioning with smart-home and AI energy-saving features. Sold via retail (e.g., Home Depot) and as OEM/ODM for other labels.

Ownership and brand-positioning details compiled from Carrier’s brand portfolio, Carrier’s Viessmann acquisition, Bosch on the Johnson Controls HVAC acquisition, Rheem / Paloma and the Nortek acquisition, Nortek/Nordyne under Rheem, ServiceTitan’s manufacturer guide, Allied Air Enterprises (Lennox), Gree / TOSOT / KINGHOME, and reporting on Midea as the manufacturer behind Cooper & Hunter and other labels and Midea vs. Cooper & Hunter, TCL’s scale and product range, and TCL air-conditioner manufacturing overview. Accurate as of July 2026; M&A in this sector moves quickly, so we revisit periodically.
